label: Collage
purpose: Display a collage of images and products in various layouts
_notes: IMPORTANT: Collage section has MAXIMUM 3 blocks only. Do NOT add more than 3 blocks. Desktop layout controls which side large image appears. Use 'image'/'video' blocks for static media and 'product'/'collection' blocks to feature products or a collection — leave their reference fields empty, the merchant assigns them later.
